review.gallery: Six distinct Raffi scenes. The bedroom and lobby JRE crops match the branded factsheet. Uncorroborated interiors and lifestyle stock were excluded.
review.location: The developer and factsheet use Al Furjan. JRE labels the nearby area Jebel Ali Village. JRE and CASADIOR publish the same rounded point. The regional map and eight approximate journey estimates come from the factsheet.
review.floorPlans: All 27 complete AFC-054B apartment sheets plus the complete first-floor plate. Every printed total verified in the visual panels. Conflicting sheets and their printed figures remain separately selectable.

unavailable: An exact entrance and a developer-issued reconciliation of the conflicting second-floor drawings were not established.
